final: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS ev, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS m FROM g) SELECT g.ev AS corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_diff, g.avg_diff - o.m AS diff_vs_overall FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.m IS NOT NULL
